claude.result: Created `slugify.py` with a `slugify` function (strip, lower, collapse spaces to hyphens) and `test_slugify.py` with 14 unittest cases covering each requirement plus edge cases like empty strings, only-spaces input, and mixed internal/external whitespace runs.

issues.description: The function does not remove whitespace at either end or collapse consecutive spaces to one hyphen, violating two explicit requirements and the required example.
issues.suggested_fix: Strip surrounding whitespace, then replace each consecutive run of spaces with a single hyphen after lowercasing (using standard-library string operations or a regular expression).

requirements.evidence: text.lower() converts characters to lowercase.
No trimming is performed; leading and trailing spaces become hyphens. The acceptance test reports '-hello-world-' for " Hello World ".
Replacing each space individually preserves runs as repeated hyphens; the acceptance test reports 'a----b--c' instead of 'a-b-c'.
For slugify(" Hello World "), the implementation returns '-hello-world-' instead of the required 'hello-world'.

result.summary: The implementation satisfies lowercase conversion but fails the trimming, space-run collapsing, and required example behaviors. Acceptance tests confirm these defects.

tests_assessment.notes: The provided unit test checks only lowercase conversion. It does not exercise trimming, repeated spaces, or the specified example; the independent acceptance tests cover these and reveal failures.

requirements.evidence: `text.lower()` converts the input to lowercase.
`text.strip()` removes whitespace from both ends.
`re.sub(r' +', '-', text)` replaces each consecutive run of spaces with one hyphen.
The implementation produces `hello-world` for `" Hello World "`; `test_example` and the independent example test pass.

result.summary: All stated requirements are met; approve.

tests_assessment.notes: The tests cover lowercase conversion, trimming both ends, collapsing repeated spaces, and the stated example. Both the implementation tests and independent acceptance tests pass.
